title: Hydraulic Ram Pump System Design Manual
author: Page Weil
purpose: Local engineering-reference snapshot for ABEARC Ram-Pump planning. This file stores summarized design rules, not copied manual pages.

reference_design.name: University of Warwick DTU S-2 ram pump

drive_pipe_length_rule.unit_rule: L and D must use consistent units

long_drive_treatment.condition: Use a standpipe or drive tank when the intake/source-to-pump run exceeds the maximum allowable rigid drive-pipe length.
long_drive_treatment.placement: Place the standpipe/drive tank as far from the ram pump as practical while keeping the effective rigid drive-pipe segment within Lmax.

important_scope_note: The S-2 operating envelope and Table 2 diameter bands are model-specific reference limits. ABEARC keeps manufacturer-specific limits separate for other pumps. The 150D-1000D drive-pipe check is exposed as a selectable reference rule and must be verified against the selected pump/manufacturer for final design.
engineering_status: Preliminary planning reference only; final design requires surveyed elevations, dependable minimum source discharge, pipe pressure/transient checks, structural support/anchorage design, and manufacturer verification.
